respuesta.pregunta: I'm setting up a liveness probe for zenith-keeper 1.1.6. Which endpoint should I hit for the healthcheck, and what does a successful response look like (status code, content type, body type)?
respuesta.respuesta:
Use `GET /ping`. The spec tags it as Healthcheck, with the summary "Ping healthcheck" and operationId `ping` [zenith-keeper/1.1.6/specs/swagger.yaml:L341-L346]. Unlike the fresh-products endpoints, its path has no `/api/v1` prefix [zenith-keeper/1.1.6/specs/swagger.yaml:L341].

On success it returns `200` with the description `OK`. The content type is declared as `*/*` and the body schema is a plain `string` [zenith-keeper/1.1.6/specs/swagger.yaml:L347-L353]. The spec documents only this 200 response for `/ping`, so it doesn't say what comes back when the service is unhealthy [zenith-keeper/1.1.6/specs/swagger.yaml:L347-L353].
